description: Start a plan, open the payment details page, cancel the membership or a Premium trial, and buy a custom domain, API credit or extra campaigns. Prices come from get_account membership, a get_membership preview or get_outreach campaigns (packs), and pricingAcceptance is the exact value the member accepted. Payment happens on a page the member opens. Actions: start_checkout, billing_portal, cancel_upgrade_trial, cancel, cancellation_feedback, buy_domain, buy_api_credits, buy_extra_campaigns. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.
